title: Integrals of tan x and sec x
back: $\int\sec x\,dx=\log\lvert\sec x+\tan x\rvert+C$; $\int\cot x\,dx=\log\lvert\sin x\rvert+C$; $\int\operatorname{cosec}x\,dx=\log\lvert\operatorname{cosec}x-\cot x\rvert+C$.

title: 1 over (x² + a²)
back: The only one of the three rational forms that gives an inverse tangent. Do not forget the $\dfrac1a$.

title: 1 over (x² − a²)
back: For $a^2-x^2$: $\dfrac{1}{2a}\log\left\lvert\dfrac{a+x}{a-x}\right\rvert+C$. Complete the square first if there is an $x$ term.

title: 1 over √(a² − x²)
back: No $\dfrac1a$ in front. With $x^2\pm a^2$ under the root the answer is $\log\left\lvert x+\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}\right\rvert+C$.

title: √(a² − x²)
back: The area integral for circles and ellipses. For $\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}$: $\dfrac x2\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}\pm\dfrac{a^2}{2}\log\left\lvert x+\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}\right\rvert+C$.

title: Integration by parts
legend: u = first function, chosen by ILATE
back: First × integral of second − integral of (derivative of first × integral of second).

title: eˣ[f(x) + f′(x)]
back: Split the bracket so that one part is the derivative of the other. Example: $\int e^x\left(\dfrac1x-\dfrac{1}{x^2}\right)dx=\dfrac{e^x}{x}+C$.

title: Partial fractions
back: Repeated factor: $\dfrac{A}{x-a}+\dfrac{B}{(x-a)^2}$. Irreducible quadratic: numerator $Bx+C$. Improper fraction: divide first.

title: Property: x → a + b − x
back: With lower limit 0: $\int_0^af(x)\,dx=\int_0^af(a-x)\,dx$. Apply, add the two forms, and $2I$ becomes easy.

title: Limits −a to a
tex: \begin{gathered}\int_{-a}^{a}f\,dx=2\int_0^a f\,dx\\ \text{if } f \text{ is even}\\ \int_{-a}^{a}f\,dx=0\\ \text{if } f \text{ is odd}\end{gathered}

title: Second fundamental theorem
back: No $+C$. If you substitute, change the limits too. Split the integral where a modulus changes sign.

title: Squares of sine and cosine
back: Lower the power before integrating. Products: $2\sin A\cos B=\sin(A+B)+\sin(A-B)$.
